patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Change Zalo package name and update the app name to allow multiple installations.

options.description: The clone number appended to the package name and app name (e.g. 2 -> Zalo Morphe 2). Leave empty to use the default name.

patches.name: Integrate ZaloXposed
patches.description: Integrates ZaloXposed using NPatch. Must be enabled for other patches to work.

options.description: Injects a file provider to manage internal app data files. Useful for backup/restore Zalo data.
Forces android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" in manifest to allow plain HTTP traffic.
